name: Online Learning Management System (LMS)
tagline: A full-stack learning platform with course discovery, interactive lessons, quizzes, PDF certificates, instructor tools, and admin moderation.
description: Developed during an internship with Codec Technologies, this Online Learning Management System combines a public course catalog and student learning player with instructor course-building tools and an administrative moderation console. It supports course search and filtering, lesson progress, private notes, bookmarks, quizzes with server-side answer evaluation, QR-stamped PDF certificates, instructor analytics, course approval workflows, and user management.
problemStatement: Learners, instructors, and administrators need a unified platform for discovering courses, delivering lessons, assessing learning, issuing certificates, and governing course quality and user access.
solution: A role-based LMS with separate public, student, instructor, and administrator experiences, backed by a Django REST API and Vue frontend.

publicWebsite: Dynamic hero banner sliders driven by backend settings
Course search and filters by category, difficulty, and free/paid pricing
Course overview with curriculum preview and learning outcomes
Instructor directory with profiles and authored courses
student: Dashboard for active, enrolled, and completed courses, active hours, and certificates
Lesson player supporting HTML text, YouTube/MP4 video, text-to-speech audio, and downloadable resources
Private per-lesson rich-text notes with create, edit, delete, and search
Timed quizzes with passing thresholds and instant score feedback
Quiz correct-answer indices hidden from API responses until server-side evaluation
QR-stamped PDF certificate generation after 100% course completion
instructor: Dashboard analytics for authored courses, draft status, enrollments, and average quiz scores
Course builder for metadata, section ordering, lessons, and quizzes
Create video, text, and audio lesson content
Submit draft courses for administrative approval
admin: Platform analytics for user growth, active courses, revenue, and issued certificates
Review pending course drafts and approve or reject with mandatory feedback
Search and filter users by STUDENT, TEACHER, and ADMIN roles
Manage hero slider banners and global website settings

certificate.eligibility: Generated when a student reaches 100% course completion

setupSteps: Create and activate a Python virtual environment
Set USE_SQLITE=True and run python backend/manage.py migrate
Set USE_SQLITE=True and run python backend/manage.py seed_lms
Set USE_SQLITE=True and run python backend/manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000
Open a separate terminal, enter frontend, run npm install
Run npm run dev in frontend
